t: What a man heard a tree say in a dream
a: اللَّهُمَّ احْطُطْ عَنِّي بِهَا وِزْرًا وَاكْتُبْ لِي بِهَا أَجْرًا وَاجْعَلْهَا لِي عِنْدَكَ ذُخْرًا
p: Allāhumma-ḥṭuṭ ʿannī bihā wizran, wa-ktub lī bihā ajran, wa-jʿalhā lī ʿindaka dhukhrā
m: O Allah, take a burden off me by it, and write a reward for me by it, and make it a store held for me with You.
